<Picture 1> is the visual identity reference for <Subject 1>.
If multiple views of the same character are present, use all views together to
maintain consistent front, profile, three-quarter, and rear appearance.

<Video 1> is a hybrid structural editing reference.

The normal RGB regions of <Video 1> define the source scene that must be preserved,
including the environment, background, other people, props, camera position,
framing, lens behavior, camera movement, lighting, spatial layout, and temporal structure.

The grayscale depth-rendered region inside <Video 1> corresponds exclusively to
the tracked subject that must be replaced by <Subject 1>.

The depth-rendered region is not visual appearance.
Do not reproduce its grayscale color, shading, texture, or depth-map appearance
in the final video.

Use the depth-rendered region only as structural and motion guidance for:
body position,
silhouette,
3D volume,
body orientation,
pose,
limb trajectory,
limb depth ordering,
head movement,
torso movement,
gesture timing,
spatial position,
and temporal motion.

summary:

[character replacement + depth-guided motion reconstruction + source scene preservation]

Replace only the depth-rendered tracked subject in <Video 1> with <Subject 1>
from <Picture 1>.

Reconstruct <Subject 1> inside the depth-defined region while following the
depth region's body position, pose, silhouette, volume, motion trajectory,
spatial relationship, and timing.

Preserve all normal RGB regions of <Video 1> as strongly as possible.
Do not modify the environment, background, other people, props, camera behavior,
composition, lighting, or shot timing unless explicitly requested.

The replacement character must retain the identity, face, hairstyle, clothing,
colors, materials, and distinctive design defined by <Picture 1> throughout
the entire video.

The grayscale depth representation must completely disappear in the final result
and be replaced by the fully rendered appearance of <Subject 1>.

No residual original subject identity,
no original face,
no original clothing,
no grayscale depth texture,
no depth-map shading,
no hybrid anatomy,
no duplicated limbs,
no character morphing,
no unintended modification of other people,
no new subjects,
no new props,
no new camera movement,
and no unintended scene changes.
